[NSBK.7.1] A backend's `backend_name` / `backend_version` are part of the
platform signature ([NDET.2.5]), and like the rest of it they are provenance
([NDET.2.1]). A series-bearing replay is bit-for-bit across platforms
([LDET.3.4.1]) and across every release of the recording's minor series
([LDET.1.10]). Each backing has one implementation ([NSBK.2.3]), and a change to
what it answers waits for a minor bump, as any change to what a program computes
does.
